task_title: Fix music play command extraction bug
summary: Fixed the music play command extraction bug in process_command(). The original code had two separate keyword lists (one in the `any()` guard check and another in the inner `for` loop) that could mismatch, and the inner loop never broke after finding a match. The fix consolidates detection and extraction into a single helper method `_extract_music_query()` that iterates keywords longest-first, returns the song name on the first match, and eliminates the dual-list inconsistency entirely.
demo_script: Sir, I've fixed the music play command extraction. Previously, the keyword detection and extraction used two different keyword lists that could mismatch, and the extraction loop never broke after finding a match. I've consolidated everything into a single-pass helper method that checks keywords in longest-first order and returns immediately on the first match. This prevents both redundant iterations and incorrect substring extraction.

changes.description: Fixed music play command extraction by consolidating keyword detection and extraction into a single-pass helper method _extract_music_query(). This eliminates the mismatch between the any() check keywords and the inner loop keywords, and uses a longest-match-first ordering with an immediate return on the first keyword match to prevent redundant iterations and wrong substring extraction.
